name: project_memory
description: Long-term memory scoped to a specific project — architecture decisions, conventions, known gotchas, 'don't do X because it broke before'. Distinct from memory_manager, which stores facts about the user rather than a project.

action.description: save a new fact, recall one by key, list all facts for a project, or delete one.

project.description: Project name to scope this to. Defaults to 'default' if omitted.

key.description: Short identifier for this fact, e.g. 'auth_flow' or 'db_choice'. Required for save/recall/delete.

value.description: The fact to remember. Required for save.
